The '''C-10 heavy blaster pistol''', also known as the '''C-10 "Dragoneye Reaper,"''' was a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] developed by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]].<ref name="Fly" />

==Characteristics==
A popular sidearm for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], and other fringers who valued firepower over subtlety, the C-10 was easily modified, larger than most other heavy blasters, and produced heavy fire that nearly rivaled a full-sized [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="Fly" />

While the rights to the C-10 were owned by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]], [[Caliban (manufacturer)/Legends|Caliban's]] [[Model X/Legends|Model X]] and [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub's]] [["Renegade" heavy blaster pistol/Legends|Renegade heavy blaster pistol]] shared many design and component similarities.<ref name="Fly" />

==Behind the scenes==
The C-10 "Dragoneye Reaper" was first identified in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', and bears a strong resemblance to another blaster in ''Galaxies'', the Renegade heavy blaster pistol. In newer sourcebook material, specifically ''[[Fly Casual]]'' and ''[[Gadgets and Gear]]'', the C-10 is a large pistol that bears little similarity to the Renegade; this has been [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] to a degree by saying that the C-10, Renegade, and the Caliban Model X all share components and design similarities.
